prompt.text:
Implement a framework-free preference form model. Export `JourneyPreferences`, `PreferenceGateway`, `Notifier`, `PreferenceForm`, and `PreferenceSnapshot`. `PreferenceForm` is constructed with a gateway, notifier, and zero-argument navigation callback. It begins with `maximumCost: null` and no providers. `setMaximumCost` stores a number or null without submission. `setProviders` accepts a mutable string array, rejects any non-string or whitespace-only entry with `TypeError`, and stores a shallow copy in the same order; duplicates are allowed. Its `snapshot` getter returns a fresh object and fresh provider array. `submit()` returns `Promise<boolean>`. It is invalid unless maximum cost is finite and strictly greater than zero; invalid submission calls `notifier.error('A positive maximum cost is required.')`, performs no save or navigation, and returns false. Otherwise it awaits exactly one `gateway.save` call with a detached snapshot. On success it calls `notifier.success('Preferences saved.')`, then navigates once, then returns true. On rejection it calls `notifier.error('Could not save preferences.')`, does not navigate, and returns false without rethrowing. External mutation of arrays or gateway arguments must never mutate form state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
